config.document_creator.disabled_desc: Enable this tool to allow the agent to create PDFs and convert documents.
config.document_creator.restart_required: Restart AuraGo to safely recreate the managed Gotenberg service.
config.document_creator.test_saved_setti: The test uses the values entered. The restart check refers to the saved configuration.
config.document_creator.test_unverified: Reachable, but network protection is not verified.
help.document_creator.allow_remote_resou: HTML and Markdown stay offline by default. Allow public images, fonts, stylesheets and scripts. Internal network addresses remain blocked.
help.document_creator.backend: Maroto is a pure Go PDF library with no external dependencies. Gotenberg is a Docker service with full document conversion, screenshots, and office format support.
help.document_creator.gotenberg_timeout: Maximum time in seconds to wait for document generation.
help.document_creator.gotenberg_url: Base URL of the Gotenberg service. Leave empty for the local address; Docker uses the gotenberg service name.
help.document_creator.output_dir: Directory where generated documents are saved.
config.document_creator.enabled_help: Allows the agent to create PDF documents and convert files between formats.
